name: Netflix
notes: From a photo of the Xbox Netflix app search screen (Nov 2026). Highlight starts on a. Y = space and X = backspace are shown on screen as gamepad shortcuts. Right of column 5 is the results grid and below the last row is the category list, so there is no safe corner to re-anchor on. No punctuation keys: '-' and apostrophes are skipped, which Netflix search tolerates.
